title: incident-bot: prioritize runbook quicklinks using SLO context and oncall heuristics
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: on recent incidents the oncall quicklinks surface a large set of runbooks which are not always relevant to the SLO context; responders waste time scanning. This PR adds a lightweight heuristic layer that scores candidate runbook quicklinks by (1) SLO signal relevance, (2) recentness of similar incidents, and (3) oncall role match, then surfaces top-N links. The feature is backward-compatible and gated behind a feature flag `ONCALL_RUNBOOK_HEURISTICS`. Changes include: SLO context enrichment to attach primary/secondary SLO tags to incidents, a runbook linker that computes a relevance score and exposes tie-breaker reasoning for UX hints, new unit and integration tests, and small docs for oncall runbook behavior. Checklist: - [x] SLO context enrichment implemented - [x] Runbook scoring & ranking implemented - [x] Feature flag gating + rollout plan - [x] Unit and integration tests added - [x] Docs/guide updated - [x] Reviewed and approved by SRE and oncall SME Implementation notes: - The heuristics are intentionally simple (weighted linear scoring) to remain explainable to oncall. We compute a score = w1*SLO_match + w2*histority + w3*role_score + w4*freshness_penalty where weights are configurable via config. Default weights tuned from historical incidents (see tools/fixtures/oncall_testdata.json). - SLO enrichment extracts top 2 related SLOs from the incident's telemetry metadata (latency, error-rate, saturation) and adds them to the incident context. - The runbook linker now returns both `links` and `explain_reasons` so the UI can show why a runbook was suggested. Backwards compatibility: when `ONCALL_RUNBOOK_HEURISTICS=false` the behavior is unchanged (randomized / chronological quicklinks). Rollout plan: start with 10% of production incidents for 48h, collect oncall feedback and acceptance metrics (click-through, helpfulness score), then increase. Related: ENG-2148 (reduce mean time to resolution by surfacing higher-quality runbooks), SUP-4121 (support ticket describing noisy runbook links).

testing_instructions: 1) Start incident-bot with ONCALL_RUNBOOK_HEURISTICS=true and load tools/fixtures/oncall_testdata.json as incident stream. 2) Confirm top runbook links match expected fixture outputs. 3) Run `go test ./...` to ensure unit/integration tests pass. 4) Toggle feature flag off to ensure previous behavior is restored.
